description: This line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank at 10 (MRR@10) for four variants of the DPR model—DPR without query expansion, DPR with corpus expansion, DPR with document expansion, and DPR with asymmetric expansion—as the number of queries used during inference increases from 1 to 10. The x-axis, labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S),” is linear and spans integer values from 1 to 10. The y-axis, labeled “MRR@10,” is linear and ranges from 33.0 to 36.0. The black line representing “DPR w/o query” remains constant at approximately 34.4 throughout the entire range. The red line for “DPR w/ corpus expansion” starts at approximately 35.2, rises slightly to a peak of about 35.7 near x=4, and then remains nearly flat at approximately 35.7 through x=10. The green line for “DPR w/ document expansion” begins at approximately 34.9, fluctuates slightly with a peak near 35.0 at x=2 and x=6, and ends at approximately 34.9. The blue line for “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion” starts at approximately 34.8, peaks at about 35.0 near x=2, dips to a low of approximately 34.5 near x=6, and ends at approximately 34.5.
